_comment: Firecracker microVM config for the Siege target (plan §7, P7.3). launch.sh fills the @...@ placeholders. Boots /init (sandbox/firecracker/build-rootfs.sh), which starts the FastAPI service on :8100. The rootfs is ephemeral and discarded on shutdown; the DB is in-memory, so nothing persists.

boot-source.boot_args: console=ttyS0 reboot=k panic=1 pci=off init=/init SIEGE_CANARY=@CANARY@
